title: Pricing the Lift Access a Snowsports School Lesson Day Needs
content:
A participant who holds neither a season pass standing in the active state nor a ticket order carrying a ski day for the session date cannot reach the teaching terrain, so the Snowsports School puts the lift access the lesson day needs on the booking as an add-on of its own.

## What the add-on comes to

The lift access add-on raised for a booking is the product's lift ticket add-on price multiplied by the number of sessions the booking holds, and the figure is rounded to the nearest cent.

A product that includes a lift ticket in its price never carries this add-on at all, and one entry is raised for each session date the access covers.

No reduction in percentage points is allowed on the add-on, so the total reduction stands at 0 points. The reductions allowed on the lift access add-on are first combined into one total in percentage points and the add-on figure, taken on the count above, is reduced once by that total; they never act one after another on what the previous one left, and the result is rounded once to the nearest cent.

## The figure on two hypothetical bookings

Take a booking of the All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson, whose lift ticket add-on price is 149.00 USD and which holds a single session. The price multiplied by the one session the booking holds is 149.00 USD. The total reduction of 0 points leaves that figure standing, and rounded once to the nearest cent the lift access add-on comes to 149.00 USD.

Take instead a booking of the Six-Week Development Programme, whose lift ticket add-on price is 119.00 USD and which holds six sessions: the price multiplied by the six sessions the booking holds is 714.00 USD, and with a total reduction of 0 points the add-on comes to 714.00 USD.

## Notes on the reckoning

- The add-on is priced on the product's lift ticket add-on price, not on the price of a lift ticket sold at the window.
- A product carrying a lift ticket in its own price carries no lift access add-on, whatever the booking holds.
- Rounding is done once, at the end, to the nearest cent.

The lift ticket add-on prices, and which products carry a lift ticket in their own price, are published product by product on the Snowsports School tariff.
